2760-4279-4446.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2760-4279-4446.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Nest of Scarabs triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2760-4279-4446.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

1074-3457-4613.easyPrerequisites:
King Macar doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Seeker of Skybreak is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
1074-3457-4613.description:
Activate King Macar using Seeker of Skybreak's ability by tapping it, untapping King Macar
King Macar triggers, allowing you to exile a creature and create a Gold token if you do.
Repeat.

1170-1329-1414-8296.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Lotus Petal from your graveyard.
Cast Lotus Petal by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

1978-2750-8190.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three creatures with different powers.
1978-2750-8190.description:
Cause Loot to become an artifact using Memnarch.
Activate Loot by tapping it, adding at least {3}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Loot.
Repeat from step 2.

1563-2457-4094-8201.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
1563-2457-4094-8201.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat from step 2

687-4050-4613-8130-8136.description:
Cast Biomathematician by paying its mana cost; it enters with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
When Biomathematician enters, it triggers, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token with a vigilance counter due to Tayam, then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Fractal you control.
Declare that you are activating Tayam's ability, so state-based actions will not be checked until the ability is activated.
While paying that ability's cost, activate the creature token using the Wall of Roots mana ability from Agatha's Soul Cauldron by putting a -0/-1 counter on it, adding {G}.
Complete the activation by paying {3} and removing a vigilance counter from each of the two creatures and a -0/-1 counter from the Fractal token.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing Biomathematician and the creature token, adding two mana.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling three and returning Biomathematician from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
687-4050-4613-8130-8136.notes: This order of operations (and the additional {2} starting mana) are necessary because you must activate mana abilities before paying costs, and so you cannot use Ashnod's Altar to get mana from the creature you need to remove counters from.

4474-4687-5115.notablePrerequisites: Gemstone Array has at least four counters on it.
4474-4687-5115.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn using its ability from Paradise Mantle by tapping it, adding one mana.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Gemstone Array.
Activate Gemstone Array as many times as necessary by removing counters from it, adding at least two mana.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Gemstone Array, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

1003-1329-2178-8095.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1003-1329-2178-8095.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2438-7173.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2438-7173.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Virulent Emissary triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2738-3967-4871-7316.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Tenacious Dead.
When Tenacious Dead dies, it, Rat King, and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Rat King trigger, creating a creature token.
In response to the remaining trigger, activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 5.
Activate two Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Tenacious Dead trigger, paying {1}{B} to return it to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Resolve the Yahenni ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4365-4772-4826-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

640-2012-7275.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is 2 or greater.
640-2012-7275.description:
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Strangleroot Geist.
Strangleroot Geist dies due to having 0 toughness, triggering its undying ability and Dross Harvester
Resolve the Dross Harvester trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Strangleroot Geist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Champion of the Weird ability from step 1, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Activate Champion of the Weird by paying 1 life and putting two -1/-1 counters on Strangleroot Geist, causing an opponent to blight 2.
Repeat.

3693-6919-7315.description:
Cast Strength of Will by paying {1}{G}, targeting Walking Ballista.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to it.
Walking Ballista triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to High Score.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 2.
3693-6919-7315.notes: You can skip step 4 if desired.

339-413-677-4460.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Blasting Station by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
When Jegantha enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control except Donatello

3259-7291-7296.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control an artifact creature.
3259-7291-7296.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Donatello and the creature that has Breath of Fury attached, triggering Donatello and Breath of Fury.
Resolve the Donatello trigger, creating a token copy of the artifact creature.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the artifact creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase

567-2308-4871-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain any amount of life.
567-2308-4871-5231.description:
Gain any amount of life.
Trudge Garden triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a 4/4 Fungus Beast creature token.
When the Fungus Beast enters, Soul's Attendant triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Fungus Beast, adding {R}.
When the Fungus Beast dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Soul's Attendant trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

141-997-6818.description:
Cast Return to Action by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Return to Action, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Return to Action.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha.
When Naru Meha dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
Resolve all Woe Strider abilities from step 5.

1274-4186-6823.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-4186-6823.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Aunt May triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

222-527-647-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-647-6797.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Phantom Train twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

586-3168-5258-5618-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying {1}
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

2060-2292-3054-6701.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
2060-2292-3054-6701.description:
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire.
When Oathsworn Vampire is sacrificed, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters equal to Szarel's power on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Repeat.
2060-2292-3054-6701.notes: This combo can put infinite +1/+1 counters on each creature you control except Szarel so long as its power is greater than the mana value of the card in your graveyard.

474-643-2034-4394.description:
Cast Everquill Phoenix for its mutate cost by paying {3}{R}, putting it under or over a non-Human creature you control.
Everquill Phoenix triggers, creating a Feather artifact token.
Cast Maskwood Nexus by paying {4}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Specimen Collector, adding {C}{C}.
When Specimen Collector dies, its second ability triggers, creating a copy of the Feather token.
Activate a Feather by paying {1} and sacrificing it, returning Specimen Collector from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Specimen Collector enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel and a 0/3 Crab creature token.
Repeat from step 4.

813-2104-3378.notablePrerequisites: You have enough mana available each turn to cast Temporal Manipulation and Illusionist's Stratagem.
813-2104-3378.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost, taking an extra turn.
Cast Illusionist's Stratagem by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages.
When Scholar of the Ages enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation and Illusionist's Stratagem from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

372-465-2781.manaNeeded: {4}{W} plus enough mana to pay for command tax, if applicable
372-465-2781.notablePrerequisites: Felidar Guardian exiled by Wormfang Drake
372-465-2781.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and command tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Wormfang Drake and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Felidar Guardian from exile to the battlefield.
When Felidar Guardian enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing Wormfang Drake to return from exile to the battlefield, and triggering both Wormfang Drake and Abdel Adrian's abilities.
Resolve the Wormfang Drake trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Wormfang Drake and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Repeat from step 3.

1-2275-4067-6282.notablePrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
Your life total is at least 2.
1-2275-4067-6282.description:
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card.
Containment Construct triggers, exiling the discarded card with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Shabraz triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Shabraz.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability.
Repeat.

222-527-969-2034.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

2201-2558-2921-5687.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Skittering Precursor triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield as a 1/1 due to Godhead of Awe, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Eldrazi Spawn.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

2092-4499-5420.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 2 or greater.
2092-4499-5420.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {1}, blinking Plundering Pirate.
When Plundering Pirate enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

238-1365-1477-2292.notablePrerequisites: Gerrard has no more than one -1/-1 counter on it.
238-1365-1477-2292.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Gerrard persist until end of turn.
Activate Extruder by sacrificing Cauldron of Souls, putting a +1/+1 counter on Gerrard.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Gerrard.
When Gerrard dies, it and its persist ability trigger.
Resolve the Gerrard persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the second Gerrard trigger, failing to exile it as it has left your graveyard, and returning Cauldron of Souls from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 3, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

687-2921-3220-5004.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three counters among creatures you control.
687-2921-3220-5004.description:
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Cathodion.
When Cathodion dies, it and Golgari Germination trigger.
Resolve the Cathodion trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Golgari Germination trigger, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token that enters the battlefield with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Tayam ability from step 1, causing you to mill three cards and return Cathodion from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat.

2190-2390-4608-4625.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to place a counter on a permanent or player.
You control at least five enchantments.
2190-2390-4608-4625.description:
Place a counter on a permanent or player.
All Will Be One triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Vraska triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on All Will Be One.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-2382-4404-4772.description:
Activate Mimic Vat by paying {3}, creating two token copies of Corridor Monitor with haste.
The Corridor Monitor tokens enter the battlefield, untapping Mimic Vat and any other permanent you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Corridor Monitor tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

391-2404-2816.notablePrerequisites:
Umbral Mantle attached to Blossom Dryad.
Blossom Dryad does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least four creatures.
391-2404-2816.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Blossom Dryad by tapping it, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Blossom Dryad by paying {3} and untapping it, giving itself +2/+2 until end of turn.
Repeat.

2034-2249-4186.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
2034-2249-4186.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing any other creature, adding {C}{C}.
Death's Presece triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
Repeat.

2302-4050-4215-4240.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cavalier of Gales, adding one mana of any color.
Cavalier of Gales and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Cavalier of Gales trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Cavalier of Gales, putting it onto the battlefield and shuffling your library.
Cavalier of Gales enters the battlefield, causing you to draw three cards and put two cards from your hand on top of your library.
Repeat.
